journey.name: Add Movie to Watchlist
journey.description: Tests the flow of selecting a movie and adding it to the user's watchlist.

actions.action: Wait for the app to load and ensure the title "Ghibli Garden" is visible.
Tap on the first movie card in the list.
Verify that the "Add to Watchlist" button is displayed at the bottom.
Verify that the button text changes to "In Watchlist".
Go back to the home screen.
Tap on the "Watchlist" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify that the selected movie appears in the watchlist.
